page.title: The right brief. The right people.
page.description: Create, manage, and refine the roles that will shape your team.
page.caption: Your roles
page.emptyFilteredText: Try another status or a different search.
page.emptyText: You have not created a job yet.

table.closeText: {{title}} will stop accepting new candidates. You can reopen it at any time.
table.deleteText: {{title}} will be removed. Only drafts can be deleted; published roles are closed instead.
table.locked: This job is restricted by moderation and cannot be published until the restriction is lifted.

wizard.description: Turn your role into structured requirements. You set the direction.
wizard.newNote: Your draft is saved to your Jobs list after the first step, and again at every step.
wizard.draftNote: This draft is saved at every step. Find it under Draft in your jobs.
wizard.liveNote: Changes to a live role are saved when you finish and show to candidates straight away.

fields.title: Job title
fields.companyHint: Your company's display name, from the Company page.
fields.briefHint: A few sentences on the team, the impact of the role and what success looks like.
fields.responsibilitiesHint: One responsibility per line, up to {{max}}. Optional, but three or more help matching.
fields.requiredSkillsHint: Skills candidates must list on their profile to be considered relevant.
fields.preferredSkillsHint: Nice to have. These never exclude a candidate. Optional.
fields.languagesHint: Optional. Candidates see the minimum level for each language.
fields.cityHint: The city sets the job's country and its salary currency.
fields.remoteCountriesHint: Optional. Leave empty to accept candidates anywhere in the EU and the UK.
fields.salaryNeedsPlace: Choose the work preference and city first: they set the currency.
fields.salaryNote: Salary is optional, but roles with a range usually attract more relevant applicants.

skills.placeholder: Type a skill and press Enter
skills.inOther: {{skill}} is already in the other skills list.

quality.intro: These checks run the same rules on the server for every job. They never rank or reject candidates.

title_words.ok: The title is specific enough for candidates to search by role and level.
title_words.warn: The title is short. Candidates search by role and level, so add both.

brief_length.ok: The brief gives enough context about the role.
brief_length.warn: The brief is under {{min}} characters. A few more sentences on the team and the impact help matching.

responsibilities.warn: Fewer than {{min}} responsibilities are listed. Add the main outcomes of the role.

required_skills.ok: {{count}} required skills are listed, a good range for matching.
required_skills.warn: {{count}} required skills are listed. {{min}} to {{max}} gives matching enough to work with.

salary_range.ok: A full salary range is visible to candidates.
salary_range.warn: No full salary range is shown. Roles with a range usually attract more relevant applicants.

review.chooseStatus: Save this role as a draft to finish it later, or publish it to list it with your open roles.
review.ready: Everything is ready. Saving updates this role straight away.

posting.noBrief: No brief has been added yet. Use Edit role to add one.

details.tip: A clear brief makes matching more useful. Review requirements regularly and keep mandatory criteria role-relevant.
details.talentEmpty: No profiles with relevant listed skills yet. Suggestions appear here as candidates update their profiles.

notices.published: Job published. It now appears in your open roles.
notices.draft: Draft saved. Find it under Draft in your jobs.
notices.saved: Changes saved. Candidates see them straight away.

notFound.title: We couldn’t find that job
notFound.text: It may have been removed, or the link may be incorrect. Your other jobs are still in the Jobs list.
